name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: If either History goes with Hale or English goes with 94% (but not both), then History goes with 89%.
Between 84% and 94%, one goes with Boyd and the other with Music.
Exactly two of these are true: Ellis goes with 84%; Hale goes with Music; Chemistry goes with 94%.
Either Hale goes with History or English goes with Boyd.

hints.text: Suppose Boyd went with History — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Boyd goes with History.
Boyd goes with History, so it can't also go with English.
History goes with Boyd, so Hale can't go with History.
…but now the clue “Either Hale goes with History or English goes with Boyd” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Boyd does not go with History.
